title: The surface server's writer commits, rebases and pushes the planning surface (Part C of seven)
summary: Part C of seven: the surface server becomes the planning surface's one writer, chantier's Board: commits the plan within 5 min, rebases, pushes every local commit (hand ones too), retries failed git steps, tells a lost stash at once, raises conflicts; writes refused with no writer.
